description: MATSim Santiago provides a MATSim Santiago scenario with an OpenStreetMap network, GTFS public transport and populations derived from the 2012 Origin-Destination Survey. The provider is MATSim scenario authors. Geographical and temporal coverage: The scenario covers Santiago, Chile. The provider describes 1% and 10% population samples and runnable scenario versions. The linked provider page supplies the access route and documentation; the resource payload was not retrieved. The licence is GPL-2.0 shown on the repository; rights in individual input datasets require separate checking. The described material is available without a stated fee. Caveats: Runnable versions are linked by the gallery but were not downloaded or executed. Planned continuous improvement does not establish current maintenance. For simulation, the documented contents can support transport network modelling and capacity planning. This use is an interpretation of the metadata, not a tested integration. It is conceptually related to model-matsim, which supplies a comparison or modelling context; compatibility is not asserted.
